also: if you were in my shoes

terms.latin: Fac quī ego sum esse tē.
evidence: Cic. Fam. 7.23.1: fac, quaesō, quī ego sum, esse tē (Lewis & Short s.v. faciō)
terms.comment: Fac with an accusative and infinitive is “suppose, imagine”: literally “make it that you are who I am”.

sources: Lewis & Short: facio
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 367.
